rules: This is the complete canonical item schema for version 0.0.1.
Do not add extra item or weapon columns unless explicitly approved in a future chat.
Fields that are not relevant to an item remain empty/null.
Weapons may use up to two separate damage components through DAMAGE_TYPE_1/2 and DAMAGE_VALUE_1/2.
Status application is represented by STATUS_ID, STATUS_STACKS and STATUS_CHANCE.
Weapon attack behavior is represented by WEAPON_TYPE, ATTACK_PATTERN, BASE_ITEM_ATTACK_SPEED, PROJECTILE_SPEED, BASE_ITEM_PROJECTILE_AMOUNT, BASE_ITEM_AOE_SIZE, KNOCKBACK and BOUNCE.
STAT_RISE and VALUE represent an item's general stat increase and allow non-weapon equipment to provide direct stat bonuses.
